suitelet.name: SUST - Seed Sustana Demo
suitelet.description: Idempotent demo-data seeder for the Sustana Recovery demo. Verifies the US/CA subsidiaries, then seeds (per checkbox) the config record, locations, lot-numbered grade items, entities, RISI index prices, settlement schedules, open PO-10001, on-hand yard lots, and an optional planning scenario. Every seeded record carries a SUSTDEMO_ externalid (custom records match by natural key), so re-running updates instead of duplicating.
